description: FDA: the labeler code and product code segments of the National Drug Code, separated by a hyphen.
FDA: brand or trade name of the drug product.
FDA: generic name(s) of the drug product.
Company that labels the product (manufacturer, repackager or distributor).
Name of the FIRST active ingredient listed. Products with several active ingredients show only the first.
FDA: the drug's dosage form, e.g. tablet or solution for injection (no fixed list).
FDA: route of administration, e.g. ORAL, TOPICAL. Blank for many bulk ingredients, which have no route.
FDA: marketing category, e.g. NDA, ANDA, BLA, OTC MONOGRAPH DRUG, BULK INGREDIENT, UNAPPROVED DRUG OTHER.
